_meta.description: Hand-written golden set for the CONSILIUM eval harness. Every entry was verified against the live retrieval/agent stack on the two synthetic sample filings (sample_filing_01 -> ACME, sample_filing_02 -> GLOBEX). See eval/golden_set/README.md for the field schema and eval/scripts/ for the runners.

categories.table_qa: answer is a structured cell from filing_tables
categories.document_qa: answer is extracted prose from filing_chunks
categories.insufficient: unanswerable from the corpus; the system MUST refuse (no citation)
categories.research: full /research graph run; scored structurally (supported claims + citations + quant)
